comment: The voices demonstrated on decklight.io. The audio is NOT in this repository: it is one release asset (`site-voices`, voices.tar.gz) that the site deploy pulls into site/voices/ (gitignored), re-voices where the deck's notes changed, checks, and pushes back. tools/site-voices.mjs is the command, pull | refresh | check | push; the workflow is .github/workflows/publish-site.yml.
style: Read in a warm, welcoming tone, like a friendly battle-hardened senior engineer who is still curious about new technology.
